assays.assay_description: Mice with implanted neodymium skull magnets or magnetic ear tags were placed in a testing chamber, habituated for 30 min, then injected with DOI, LSD, lisuride and/or M100907 (or vehicle). Head twitches were detected via magnetometer and processed by signal analysis + deep-learning scalogram classifier. Total HTR over the first 30 min and minute-by-minute time courses (up to 3 h) were analysed. Used to characterize tolerance, cross-tolerance, antagonist blockade, and β-arrestin2 dependence.

outcomes.summary: Acute DOI and LSD increased HTR; repeated daily administration of DOI (4 days) or LSD (4 days) produced progressive tolerance (~50% reduction). Tolerance to DOI was already evident 24 h after a single dose, was surmountable by a higher dose, and was prevented by pretreatment with M100907 (1 mg/kg). Cross-tolerance occurred between LSD and DOI but not between lisuride and either psychedelic. Tolerance developed equivalently in WT and β-arrestin2 KO mice.
outcomes.statistics: DOI tolerance: time F[6,135]=30.75, p<0.001; day-1 treatment F[2,135]=49.40, p<0.001; one-way ANOVA F[2,19]=6.59, p<0.01. M100907 effect: F[3,112]=72.54, p<0.001; t8=2.87, p<0.05. Dose surmount: t8=3.60, p<0.01. β-arr2: genotype F[1,40]=0.43, p>0.05. LSD tolerance: F[1,90]=24.58, p<0.001; t18=4.14, p<0.001. LSD→DOI cross-tolerance: t18=2.17, p<0.05. Lisuride lack of cross-tolerance: F[1,56]=0.03, p>0.05.
outcomes.evidence: repeated (4 days) administration of the psychedelic... judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single HTR assay; merged into one entry as the rubric collapses dose/antagonist/genotype/cross-tolerance variants into one paradigm.
B1 set to 2-3 (score 1): paper reports total 30-min HTR counts, time-course (minute-binned) HTR, and pre-lisuride spontaneous HTR — multiple distinct measures.
B7 scored 1 because the paper explicitly used a deep learning scalogram-based classifier in addition to magnetometer signal analysis.
D2 scored 2 (61 min–6 h) based on explicit 3 h monitoring in Supplementary Figure 1.
D4 scored Yes because spontaneous HTR was measured for 30 min prior to lisuride and reported (pre-drug baseline within the same assay/session).
food/water_restriction set to 'during' (standard short test, ad libitum in home cage but no access in testing chamber).
Added Lisuride and M100907 as dosing entries since both were administered to animals in the behavioural experiments (lisuride is an active comparator psychedelic-related compound).
